svg.text: Five bedrooms • Main-level parents’ suite • Island kitchen • Separate laundry • Upstairs kitchenette
Space-first concept: approximately 3,868 sq ft enclosed, plus porch, deck and upper outdoor areas
AMERICAN LAYOUT: welcoming foyer → open kitchen / dining / great room → rear patio
W.I.C. = walk-in closet. Dimensions are approximate planning zones; finished clear sizes depend on walls.
Five bedrooms, five bathrooms, two kitchens, laundry and storage. Garage is not included.
Concept only. A local architect must resolve structure, egress, ventilation, stair geometry, setbacks and plumbing.
Not constrained to the previous ₹45 lakh budget. Footprint and outdoor areas have not been approved for a specific site.
